title: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis Steps Down
description: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis has stepped down as part of a shake-up of the AI lab, according to Financial Times.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: Google DeepMind is an artificial intelligence lab owned by Google's parent company Alphabet.

sections.heading: News
paragraphs: Financial Times reports that Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis has stepped down in a shake-up of the AI lab.
CNBC reports that Google's chief scientist Jeff Dean is also exiting the company after 27 years.

sections.heading: Statement from Google
paragraphs: Google's blog post titled 'The next chapter of our AI momentum' discusses the changes in leadership within the company's AI division.
